description: This file defines interfaces and classes for a Thrift server, including event handling, server management, and configuration functions.

classes.name: TServerEventHandler
classes.description: Interface class for handling server events, meant to be subclassed by users to implement custom behavior.

classes.name: TServer
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a Thrift server with methods for starting, stopping, and configuring server components.

methods.name: preServe
methods.description: Called before the server begins operation.

methods.name: createContext
methods.description: Creates a context for a new client connection.

methods.name: deleteContext
methods.description: Deletes a client connection context after request handling.

methods.name: processContext
methods.description: Handles processing of a client request context.

methods.name: serve
methods.description: Starts the server; pure virtual function to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs the server by calling serve().

methods.name: getProcessorFactory
methods.description: Returns the processor factory used by the server.
